description: First operator-valued HOMFLYPT probe: per-partition Markov trace of the canonical pipeline proton/neutron braids (WITH averaged crossings I = σ − (h/2)·1). These break the amphicheirality found in the pure-braid HOMFLYPT (PR #1043) and give P(proton) ≠ P(neutron). Records per-partition character traces, Markov-trace split, and implied E₀ calibration.

data.per_partition_note: averaged crossings are not representable in chi_lambda_braid word form; per-partition character traces are omitted
